021import net.tnemc.core.currency.item.ItemDenomination;
022
023import java.math.BigDecimal;
024import java.util.ArrayList;
025import java.util.UUID;
026
027/**
028 * Represents a denomination for an {@link Currency currency}.
029 *
030 * @author creatorfromhell
031 * @see Currency
032 * @since 0.1.2.0
033 */
034public class Denomination {
035
036  private UUID identifier;
037  private String single;
038  private String plural;
039  private BigDecimal weight;
040
041  public Denomination(final BigDecimal weight) {
042
043    this.weight = weight;
044    this.single = "Singular";
045    this.plural = "Plural";
046  }
047
048  public static Denomination clone(final Denomination original, final boolean item) {
049
050    final Denomination cloned = (item)? new ItemDenomination(original.weight()) : new Denomination(original.weight());
051
052    cloned.setSingle(original.singular());
053    cloned.setPlural(original.plural());
054    cloned.setWeight(original.weight());
055
056    if(cloned instanceof final ItemDenomination clonedItem && original instanceof final ItemDenomination itemDenomination) {
057
058      clonedItem.enchantments(new ArrayList<>(itemDenomination.enchantments()));
059      clonedItem.flags(new ArrayList<>(itemDenomination.flags()));
060      clonedItem.setLore(new ArrayList<>(itemDenomination.getLore()));
061      clonedItem.material(itemDenomination.material());
062      clonedItem.setDamage(itemDenomination.getDamage());
063      clonedItem.setName(itemDenomination.getName());
064      clonedItem.setCustomModel(itemDenomination.getCustomModel());
065      clonedItem.setTexture(itemDenomination.getTexture());
066    }
067
068    return cloned;
069  }
070
071  public boolean isItem() {
072
073    return (this instanceof ItemDenomination);
074  }
075
076  public UUID identifier() {
077
078    return identifier;
079  }
080
081  public void identifier(final UUID identifier) {
082
083    this.identifier = identifier;
084  }
085
086  public void setSingle(final String single) {
087
088    this.single = single;
089  }
090
091  public void setPlural(final String plural) {
092
093    this.plural = plural;
094  }
095
096  public String singular() {
097
098    return single;
099  }
100
101  public String plural() {
102
103    return plural;
104  }
105
106  public BigDecimal weight() {
107
108    return weight;
109  }
110
111  public void setWeight(final BigDecimal weight) {
112
113    this.weight = weight;
114  }
115}
